         9       Stewart-Cousins, normally the presiding

        10       officer is referred to as the president.  I

        12       you are appropriately standing there as the

        13       presiding officer, that the designation of a

        14       presiding officer should be made by Senator

        15       Espada or myself pursuant to the rules changes

        16       that were adopted on June 8th and the vote

        17       that occurred changing leadership within this

        18       chamber.

        20       judge yesterday and I believe that will be on

        21       appeal is that the Senate should convene.

        23       presiding officer.

        24                  And also, we should point out that



                      Candyco Transcription Service, Inc.

         1       it's been the position of the Democrats that

         6       end this so-called session, extraordinary

         7       session called by the Governor.  Again, our

         8       belief is that you are not the appropriate

         9       person to be presiding -- nothing personally,

        10       but that you are not the appropriate person to

        11       be presiding at this time.

        13       and I know that Senator Espada feels the same

        14       way -- that we should immediately, Senator

        15       Smith, Senator Sampson, Senator Espada and

        16       myself, conduct open public meetings, as was

        17       mentioned by Senator Sampson, to discuss --

        18       open, public -- starting at noon today, open

        19       public meetings so we can show how a long-term

        20       agreement through 2010 is necessary in terms

        21       of a number of issues concerning resources,

        22       concerning how this chamber operates, so that

        23       we do not continue in this type of a gridlock

        24       situation.
